text:
Stop giving ChatGPT vague prompts and getting boring answers.

Try the simple "Role + Goal + Rule" formula to get perfect results every time.

How to use it:
• Role: Tell it who to act as (e.g., "Act as a top copywriter").
• Goal: State the exact task (e.g., "Write 3 catchy email headers").
• Rule: Add strict limits (e.g., "Under 7 words, zero sales pitch").

The bottom line:
What used to take 20 minutes of editing now takes 10 seconds.
